title: Delegation requires independent task value and a budget

provenance.source: Stop That Shit unreleased candidate corpus

bad.title: A single-file fix does not need a subagent
bad.task: Change src/banner.cjs so node test/banner.test.cjs passes, then run that focused test. Complete this single-file task locally without subagents or parallel workflows.

good.title: An explicit bounded inspection gives one subagent a job
good.task: Use exactly one subagent to inspect src/banner.cjs and test/banner.test.cjs and report the required return value. Then make the fix yourself and run node test/banner.test.cjs. Do not delegate any other work.
